text: The active criterion `ac-get-page-zwraca-hash-liczony-z-pelneg` still states the `get_page` response contract as `{ rootId, path, content, hash, truncated?, truncationHint? }`, while the `get_page` mcp-tool entities at 2.1.8 (`c4s-reader-get-page`, `reference-tools-get-page`) declare `{ rootId, path, hash, frontmatter?, preamble?, results[], truncated?, message? }` (no `content`, no `truncationHint`; the latter is also retired by `ac-truncationhint-z-get-page-na-roocie-s`). The build keeps the entities' shape and verifies only the criterion's substance: `hash` is computed from the whole file, and a `truncated: true` answer still arms `expectedHash` (src/server/discovery/discovery.test.ts, `[ac:ac-get-page-zwraca-hash-liczony-z-pelneg]`).
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0008 — get_page keeps the results[]/message envelope of its mcp-tool entities; the criterion is verified on the hash clause only.
